line: A Sunday-morning bike ride through the city — bakery, park, riverside — each stop adding an ink until three misregistered plates overprint.
line_cn: 周日早晨骑车穿过城市：面包店、公园、河边，每到一处加一版油墨，最后三版套印。

transitions: Transitions: overprint growths, roller sweeps, shape match cuts, hard cuts on beats.
Never a cross-dissolve, never a soft digital wipe.
labels: Type is printed: titles and subtitles live on one plate, so they misregister and grain with it. A title can be printed on two plates with a visible offset: the riso double-hit.
Fonts (OFL): heavy grotesque for titles (e.g. Bricolage Grotesque 800), geometric sans for captions (e.g. Jost 500–700). Preload every weight before READY.
Subtitles: a paper-white knockout strip (zero ink, small radius) with text on one plate, ~40–46 px; its edges catch misregistration fringes. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
Prints don't fade: titles arrive with a roller wipe or on a beat and leave on a cut.
motion: Characters act on twos (12 fps); camera moves on ones (24 fps): a stepped camera reads as judder.

Registration is not jittered every frame. One fixed set of offsets per shot (±1–3 px). A kick (≈ 8–14 px, decaying in ~0.25 s with slight ringing) on an accent; a drift up to ~25 px through a held moment, snapping back on the downbeat.
Grain boils partly (about a third re-rolls per print); sheet streaks and blots change only at cuts.
Simple cycles on few drawings; secondary motion (scarf, flag, tail) as a travelling sine wave.

native_moves.name: Plates as narrative
native_moves.does: The world gains a plate at each turning point.
native_moves.fits: a product arriving as a new ink; a city history, one ink per era; colour returning during a recovery.

native_moves.name: Two inks, a third where they meet
native_moves.fits: a merger; a duet; two data sets whose overlap is the finding.

native_moves.name: Overprint transition
native_moves.does: A shape of one ink grows over the frame, turning everything beneath into the mix, then shrinks into the next scene's key shape.
native_moves.fits: a pill dissolving; a spotlight becoming a moon; a stamp becoming a map pin.

native_moves.name: Registration as rhythm and feeling
native_moves.does: Kicks on accents, drift in a held moment, snap on the downbeat.
native_moves.fits: nerves before a speech; dizziness; a memory coming into focus.

native_moves.name: Reflections as separated plates
native_moves.does: Each plate wobbles on its own phase.
native_moves.fits: a shop window; heat over a road; a coffee surface.

native_moves.name: Knockout reveal
native_moves.does: A shape made only of missing ink; its plate arrives later.
native_moves.fits: a missing piece; a secret; a logo hidden in plain sight.

native_moves.name: Halftone scale
native_moves.does: Dots grow into shapes as the camera pushes in.
native_moves.fits: population; rainfall; a crowd that turns out to be people.

native_moves.name: It is a sheet of paper
native_moves.does: The print can be stacked, folded, cut or pinned; grain boils like a flipbook of prints.
native_moves.fits: a zine; a poster series; a flyer passed hand to hand.
